description:
O Christmas Tree Cartoon! — O Christmas tree, O Christmas tree, how lovely are your branches! But why do pine trees stay bright green when all other trees lose their leaves?
Kids science answer for "evergreen trees for kids science" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Pine needles are narrow and covered in a thick waterproof waxy coating that locks in moisture during freezing winter, with natural antifreeze inside cells so leaves don't freeze and fall!
